sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: Australian designer Adam Goodrum drew on a classic childhood game to create this lighting collection for design brand Rakumba. The Hangman lighting collection includes table, floor and ceiling lights, each composed of an extruded aluminium rod that can be kinked into different geometric compositions using a specially designed articulated joint.
